registered: 2026-10-14, before any result of this study was seen (Market Lab has not yet run it on any symbol)
why: Owner (2026-10-14): each Deriv family behaves differently, as Deriv's own descriptions say; TTI partly categorised them. Test, family by family, whether the behaviour each family is declared to have shows in the broker's own history and whether the rule that behaviour implies pays after the spread.
data: The owner's Deriv cTrader account, closed M1 bars, the last 21 days (Market Lab 'Study: days of M1 history'), every symbol matched by the study keywords; spread = the symbol's ask - bid when measured

families_and_rules.DriftSwitch N (N = declared average regi: momentum follow: lookback L in {N/4, N/2} bars, enter when |L-bar move| >= 1.0 x sigma x sqrt(L), hold H in {N/4, N/2} bars (4 rules)
families_and_rules.RangeBreak: range = last w bars' high/low, w in {30, 120}. Fade: close in the top/bottom 10% -> sell/buy, target the middle, stop 0.25 width beyond the edge, max w bars. Break: close beyond the range by 0.1 width -> follow, target 1 width, stop 0.25 width back inside (4 rules)
families_and_rules.Boom, Crash, Hybrid, DEX: spike direction from the name (else from the jumps, if 80% one way). TTI's overdue rule: enter in the spike direction once the wait since the last spike exceeds k x the average gap so far, k in {0.7, 1.0}; exit at the first spike or after one average gap. Drift follow against the spikes: tp 1 / sl 2 ATR and tp 0.5 / sl 3 ATR, max 60 bars (4 rules)
families_and_rules.Jump: TTI's 'jump recent': after a jump bar, follow or fade for 5 or 30 bars (4 rules)
families_and_rules.Step, MultiStep: TTI's 'streak': after k in {5, 7} bars closing the same way, follow or fade for 5 bars (4 rules)
families_and_rules.SkewStep, Trek, DailyReset: hold in the direction the name declares (Up/Bull long, Down/Bear short; both directions if undeclared) for 60 or 240 bars, back to back (2 or 4 rules)
families_and_rules.Volatility, VolatilitySwitch, Unknown: controls: momentum follow and fade, lookback 15, z 1.5, hold 15 (2 rules)

measurements: per symbol: spread in units of the typical 1-minute move; jumps per hour and up share; 'is a jump due?' = jump rate when the wait since the last jump is above half the median gap over the rate below it (memoryless = about 1); variance ratios at 5/15/60/240 minutes; lag-1 autocorrelation; volatility memory (autocorrelation of |moves| at 60 minutes); drift per hour between jumps and net, with z
pass: CANDIDATE: t >= 3.5 on the whole history, at least 50 trades, AND a positive average in both halves, after the spread (MarketLab.CandidateT). A candidate then needs a fresh forward period on later data, the same rule unchanged, before any engine is considered (ADR-0011).
declared_behaviour_checks: recorded, not pass/fail: Drift Switch VR at its regime length above 1; Range Break VR60 below 1; Jump about 3 jumps an hour, half up; Boom/Crash/DEX jumps one way and late/early about 1; net drift z within +-2 for every family except Trek and Daily Reset, whose names declare a direction
validated_by: tests/Zugrio.CBot.Core.Tests/BehaviourTests.cs: the rules find the structure on generated paths that have it (drift regimes, a bouncing range, a 'due' spike, a sticky step, a declared drift) and none on paths that do not (random walk, memoryless spikes, fair steps, symmetric jumps)
unchanged_after_registration: Behaviour.cs rules and the pass rule. Any later rule is a new registration, tested on later data.

amendment_1.when: 2026-10-14, before any data for this study was downloaded and before any result
amendment_1.why: Deriv's public feed (wss://api.derivws.com/trading/v1/options/ws/public, the endpoint TTI uses) is reachable from the research container, so the study can run here on longer history instead of waiting for Market Lab runs.
amendment_1.data: Deriv M1 candles from that feed (Deriv's quoted prices, not the cTrader bid/ask), for every synthetic it serves in a studied family: Drift Switch DSI10/20/30; Range Break RB100/200; DEX 600/900/1500 UP/DN; Daily Reset RDBULL/RDBEAR; Step stpRNG..stpRNG5; Hybrid VOLBOOM/VOLCRASH 400/550/750; Boom and Crash 50/150/300/500/600/900/1000; Jump 10-100; Volatility R_10..R_100 and 1s 10-250 as controls. Not served under any name tried (Trek, Multi Step, Skew Step, Volatility Switch): left to Market Lab on the owner's cTrader account. Baskets are forex/gold baskets, not generators: out of scope.
amendment_1.periods: REGISTERED window = the last 21 days (as registered). CONFIRMATION window = the 69 days before it (independent data from the same generator). A CANDIDATE must pass the registered rule on the 21 days (t >= 3.5, >= 50 trades, positive both halves) AND, with the same rule unchanged, have a positive average with t >= 2 on the 69 days.
amendment_1.spread: Deriv's published CFD spread for the instrument (deriv.com trading specifications), in price units, applied once per trade. Where no spread is published, the rules are reported at zero spread (gross, an upper bound) and no candidate is declared for that symbol until its cTrader spread is measured.
amendment_1.runner: research/deriv/StudyRunner calls Behaviour.Classify, Behaviour.Profile and Behaviour.Candidates unchanged; names passed to Classify are Deriv's display names (DSI10 -> 'Drift Switch Index 10', DEX600UP -> 'DEX 600 UP Index', VOLBOOM400 -> 'Vol over Boom 400', RDBULL -> 'Bull Market Index', stpRNG2 -> 'Step Index 200').
